description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Integration Engineer with expertise in Mulesoft to join our team.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining integration solutions to ensure seamless connectivity across diverse systems and platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to implement Mulesoft-based integration strategies that align with business needs and technical requirements.

The goal of this function is to develop new methods and interfacing in support of business projects or to enhance the business capabilities of existing interfaces between the IT systems in our landscape. The development is typically based on analysis provided by Functional Consultant and approved by Technical Designer. This function is essential to ensure the evolution of SAP and non SAP integration with other systems with a high level of quality. As we are evolving towards a decentralized environment, application connectivity is a key component in design and a high usage of APIs is expected.

Responsibilities:

  • Ability to deliver high quality results meeting established standards and expectations for the organization.
  • Work with functional consultants and business analysts to build specified development requirements as well as test and document the work.
  • Configuring Queue Management, Alert Management, Performance setup, Integration Directory and SLD (System Landscape Directory)
  • Design, develop, test, debug APIs in our Mulesoft platform.
  • Deliver CI / CD using established platforms (Github, CTS+)
  • Ensure all activities are executed within the agreed planning and budget, and continuously stay focused on delivering high quality solutions.
  • Following the Change management and Life cycle management policies and procedures.
  • Following the development standards.
  • Incident identification, problem solving, and documentation.

Requirements: 

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as Mulesoft Engineer in Mulesoft integration Projects
  • Proven experience with enterprise integration, API design, and development.
  • Experience with both cloud and on-premise integration solutions
  • Strong understanding of Mulesoft components (API Gateway, Anypoint Exchange, etc.) and connectors, API integration design, Mulesoft Anypoint Platform, Mulesoft RTF
  • Experience with RESTful web services, API design, and security best practices (OAuth, JWT)
  • Familiarity with databases, messaging systems (JMS, MQ), and cloud platforms (Azure).
  • Knowledge in process integration design (communications and messaging technologies), enterprise integration patterns.
  • Good knowledge of Dataweave, mule connector modules and API specification languages(RAML or Swagger)
  • Experience in developing REST APIs and consuming 3rd party web services
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, training and team leading skills and the ability to work effectively within a development team. Capable of providing leadership, mentoring of junior developers and technical support. 
  • Preferred knowledge in JAVA development.

Nice to have:

  • SAP PI or Cloud Platform Integration exp.
  • Source control tools, such as Git
  • Docker and Kubernetes.
  • RDBMs systems programming
  • Kafka 
  • Azure (Log analytics, AKS, Gateway, Keyvault, Blob Storage, Event Hub, Service Bus)

We offer:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits
